a2-221.title: Communicative Challenge: Do You Have a Pet?
a2-221.scenario: Meg is visiting Gábor's family. Gábor asks whether she has a pet.
a2-221.prompt: Tell Gábor that you have a small cat and that you feed it every morning.
cues: Say you have a small cat
Say you feed it every morning
a2-221.target: Van egy kicsi macskám, és minden reggel etetem.
a2-221.english: I have a small cat, and I feed it every morning.
a2-221.canDo: I can say which pets I have and describe them.

a2-222.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Farm
a2-222.scenario: Petra has never been to Gábor's grandparents' farm. She asks Károly what animals there are.
a2-222.prompt: Tell Petra that there are two horses and five hens on the farm.
a2-222.target: A tanyán van két ló és öt tyúk.
a2-222.english: On the farm there are two horses and five hens.
a2-222.canDo: I can name the animals on a farm and say how many there are.

a2-223.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungary on the Map
a2-223.scenario: Károly is showing Meg a map of Hungary and asks what she already knows about the country.
a2-223.prompt: Tell Károly that the Danube flows through Budapest and that Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary.
cues: Say the Danube flows through Budapest
Say Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary
a2-223.target: A Duna Budapesten keresztül folyik. A Balaton a legnagyobb tó Magyarországon.
a2-223.english: The Danube flows through Budapest. Lake Balaton is the biggest lake in Hungary.
a2-223.canDo: I can name forests, hills, lakes and fields in a landscape.

a2-224.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans for Sunday
a2-224.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she wants to do on Sunday.
a2-224.prompt: Tell Petra that you are going hiking in the forest on Sunday and that you love nature.
cues: Say you are going hiking in the forest on Sunday
a2-224.target: Vasárnap az erdőbe megyek túrázni. Nagyon szeretem a természetet.
a2-224.english: On Sunday I am going hiking in the forest. I love nature very much.
a2-224.canDo: I can name flowers, trees and grass and say what I see in nature.

a2-225.title: Communicative Challenge: Back from the Village
a2-225.scenario: It is Monday and Petra asks Meg how the weekend trip was.
a2-225.prompt: Tell Petra that on Saturday you were in a small village, fed the hens and saw a stork.
cues: Say you were in a small village on Saturday
Say you fed the hens and saw a stork
a2-225.target: Szombaton egy kicsi faluban voltam, etettem a tyúkokat, és láttam egy gólyát.
a2-225.english: On Saturday I was in a small village, I fed the hens, and I saw a stork.
a2-225.canDo: I can tell what I did on a weekend trip to the countryside.

a2-225-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling the Family
a2-225-consolidation.scenario: Meg is having dinner with Károly's family and tells them about the weekend in the village.
a2-225-consolidation.prompt: Tell them that you walked the dog in the forest, that there are many flowers in the grass, and that you love nature.
cues: Say you walked the dog in the forest
Say there are many flowers in the grass
a2-225-consolidation.target: Sétáltattam a kutyát az erdőben. A fűben sok virág van, és nagyon szeretem a természetet.
a2-225-consolidation.english: I walked the dog in the forest. There are many flowers in the grass, and I love nature very much.
a2-225-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about pets, farm animals and the countryside, and tell about a weekend trip.
